DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Skin.

Based on your history of diabetes, the lesion's growth over two months, and the absence of pain, the clinical picture strongly suggests a non-melanoma skin cancer, specifically Squamous Cell Carcinoma. I have already requested images to confirm the presence of central keratinization or ulceration.
